items.title: 2.5 Python Modules and Built-in Data Structures

blocks.title: Data structure
blocks.text: A data structure is a particular way of organizing and storing data; a list is one example. Python has a large standard library of built-in modules and data structures.
This section covers functions, modules and libraries, and the next one Python's built-in data structures.

blocks.prompt: What is a data structure? Give an example.
blocks.explanation: A way of organizing and storing data so it can be used efficiently, such as a list.

items: Data structure: a format for organizing data (list); Python's standard library has many modules and structures.
